details: Architected and deployed scalable, event-driven microservices using Java 17, Spring Boot, and Apache Kafka, processing 10M+ daily events for healthcare claims and policy workflows with 99.99% availability.

Implemented distributed transaction workflows across billing and policy underwriting services using the Saga Pattern (Orchestration & Choreography) and Outbox Pattern, guaranteeing eventual consistency across heterogeneous datastores without 2PC overhead.
Engineered low-latency search and retrieval pipelines using Elasticsearch, designing custom analyzer mappings and typeahead query DSLs that reduced p99 search latency by 65% (from 450ms to <150ms).

Refactored legacy monolithic services into modular, extensible microservices adhering to SOLID principles and GoF design patterns (Strategy, Factory, Observer, Decorator), increasing unit test coverage from 45% to 88% using JUnit and Mockito.

Scaled database architecture by implementing MySQL/Oracle Master-Slave read replication and horizontal table partitioning, paired with multi-tier Redis distributed caching, reducing database read contention by 55%.

Engineered system resilience and fault tolerance utilizing Resilience4j circuit breakers, token-bucket rate limiting, and graceful degradation, applying CAP and PACELC trade-offs to withstand high-volume traffic surges.
Streamlined CI/CD deployment automation using Jenkins pipelines, enforcing automated CodeQL static analysis and SonarQube quality gates to maintain 0 critical/high vulnerabilities in production.

Singapore Wealth & Asset Management System: Architected backend microservices for automated portfolio rebalancing workflows, executing real-time asset allocation calculations for $500M+ in assets under management (AUM).
Engineered secure, idempotent RESTful APIs integrating with third-party banking gateways and financial settlement networks, reducing API transaction failure rates by 40%.
Optimized complex SQL queries, transaction boundaries, and Hibernate ORM configurations, improving end-of-day batch settlement execution time by 35%.
Australia Logistics & Order Management: Designed and developed core order processing and shipment tracking REST APIs using Java, Spring Boot, and JPA, handling 200K+ daily orders.
Applied State and Strategy design patterns to manage multi-stage order lifecycles; optimized database indexing and HikariCP connection pools, reducing API response times by 30% during peak windows.
US Healthcare & Enterprise Case Management: Developed core Java modules, data transformation utilities, and scheduled batch jobs supporting critical public assistance workflows.
Authored robust unit and integration test suites using JUnit and Mockito (85%+ code coverage); resolved client-reported defect tickets ahead of strict SLA deadlines.
